verdict.rationale: The docs explicitly document image input: reasoning models 'accept text and image inputs', and GPT-5.5 lists 'image input' among its capabilities. Audio input is covered through realtime voice, with microphone input over WebRTC. Direct document input (e.g. sending a PDF to the model) is not documented; only retrieval via the file search tool appears, which is an adjacent capability, and per-model modality coverage is not spelled out. missing for 10: documented direct document/PDF input, audio input for standard Responses requests (beyond the realtime voice path), per-model input-modality matrix, independent hands-on corroboration of multimodal input.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send images, audio, or documents to the model — or the docs honestly scope the model to text-only input

citations.quote: These reasoning models accept text and image inputs and generate text through the Responses and Chat Completions APIs.
GPT-5.5 supports a 1M token context window, image input, structured outputs, function calling
Use WebRTC for browser voice applications. Microphone input and generated speech travel on negotiated media tracks.
